findings.quoted_text: EKR shall pay to PPI, any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.

EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D], any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.
findings.explanation: Payment is due within 45 days of the end of each quarter, which delays your receipt of payments beyond standard terms and impacts your cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D], any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within thirty (30) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose an adjustment to the relevant clause: - The current timeline sets payment within forty-five days, which delays your receipt of payments and impacts cash flow, so we propose changing it to thirty days with the following wording: EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D], any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within thirty (30) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9. Thank you, and best regards.
